items.quote: Frist: ein Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter itself notes it was posted ('zur Post gegeben') on 30.03.2026, which is later than and controls over the printed Bescheiddatum of 26.03.2026 for determining Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 30.03.2026 + 4 days = 03.04.2026 (a Friday, which is Karfreitag, a public holiday in NW). Because the deemed-delivery day falls on a holiday, it shifts to the next working day: Tuesday 07.04.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month objection period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later, on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thursday 07.05.2026. That day is a normal working day, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The letter's printed Bescheiddatum (26.03.2026) differs from the stated posting date ('zur Post gegeben am 30.03.2026'); the later posting date was used to compute Bekanntgabe, as it is the legally relevant date and is later than the document date.

As of today (2026-09-26), both the payment due date (30.04.2026) and the Einspruch deadline (07.05.2026) have already passed; if payment or objection have not been made, contact the Finanzamt immediately about late payment interest, enforcement, and the possibility of a late objection (Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand) if there was a valid excuse.
